title: 第1章 比斗
content_zh:
通灵学院位于飞羽王朝郊外，历史悠久，培养了一代代的人才。学院共分为两大部，文部和武部。同时分初级班和高级班，初级班六岁到十二岁，高级班十二岁到二十岁。

今日刚好是初级班文部的文试，文试只有初级班毕业的学员才可以参加。飞羽王朝以武治国，但是要的并不是纯粹的武夫。

考场之中，一名眉目清秀的少年，从容的应答着考卷上的题目。整个考场均是衣着华丽的少年少女，唯独这名少年一身朴素的衣裳。

他叫上官羽，是飞羽王朝左将军上官惊鸿的第三子。自小不能修炼武道，被好事者称为废物羽。

“上官羽，把你的考卷给我，我们交换下！”后面一名华服少年用脚踢了下上官羽。

上官羽头都没回，他知道踢他的人肯定是武子明。武家与上官家向来矛盾不断，上官惊鸿为左将军，武冲霄为右将军。两人互看对方不顺眼，也都不服对方。

“毕业文试，可不是开玩笑的，不能作弊的！”

“好，废物羽你给我等着，文试结束你就完了！”武子明一只手捏着笔，一只手紧握着拳头，狠狠地等着上官羽。

武子明咬牙切齿，神色不善。这时候上官羽看了看自己的考卷，突然转过头来。

“好啊，武子明我们马上可以出去了！”上官羽满脸笑容，可是在武子明看来就是恶魔的微笑了。

“上官羽，武子明，文试不准交头接耳！念在你们读书不易，就罚你们现在交卷！立刻，马上，出去！”

文部考官王通，也是上官羽他们的授课夫子。这是一位让人敬重的老者，满头白发梳理的整整齐齐，浑身衣服没有一丝褶皱。为人刚正不阿，不慕权贵，做事一丝不苟。

上官惊鸿和武冲霄，权倾朝野，各掌百万大军。上官羽和武子明，自然不能轻易得罪。其他考官看到他们作弊，也就睁一只眼闭一只眼。唯独王通丝毫不惧，更是将他们撵了出去。

上官羽淡然的走出门外，甚至面上还带着淡淡的微笑。

只是他没有看到，考场内一名少年的冷笑。这个少年正是上官惊鸿的二儿子，上官建城。

武子明却一脸愤恨，被王通抓到，只能被迫走出考场。要不是上官羽故意那样做，他是不会被撵出考场的。

“废物羽，你别走，咱俩到演武场去！”武子明刚一出门，就冲着不远处的上官羽吼道。

“自然奉陪，也不知道谁更废物，每次都叫侍卫帮忙！”

“你…！哼，现在我已经修炼到人极境巅峰了，不是你这个废物能比的！你又不能修炼武道，永远也体会不到天地元气的美妙！”武子明一脸得意，上官惊鸿二子上官建城他是打不过，不过欺负这个废物还是可以的。

上官羽没有多言，他大步走向学院的演武场中。武子明也赶紧跟上，两人对演武场可都熟悉的很。

这个时候，学院的兵器库没有开放，他们两个只能徒手搏斗了。

一阵风吹过，尘土飞扬，两人对望。

武子明一脸冷笑，人极境巅峰的他可不认为上官羽会是他的对手。

两人自小就爱打架，只是武子明每次都是被上官羽狂揍。上官羽自小就气力惊人，远超同龄人。没有修炼到人极境之前的武子明，哪里会是上官羽的对手呢。

今日上官羽害他是一方面，另一方面，也是修炼到人极境巅峰，信心暴涨，想一雪前耻。

他也不想想，要不是他找威胁上官羽，上官羽又怎么会如此对他？上官羽也不是吃亏的主儿，况且两人一直有仇。

武子明一拳打向上官羽，没有什么花哨，就是直直的打来。上官羽一侧身，等武子明冲了过来，出拳打向武子明的腰部。武子明转身，双拳迎击上官羽。

两人双拳对轰了一击，武子明却往后退了几步。这对他来说，太不可思议了，人极境巅峰的他竟然还不如不能修炼的上官羽。

“看我武家绝技，武动山河！”武子明运转元气，全身的力量集中于双拳之上。这并不是一拳，而是连续三拳，一拳比一拳威猛。

上官羽一矮身，一条腿横扫，武子明立马跳开。就是这么一耽误，武子明失去了先机，连续三拳却只挥出了一拳。

上官羽自是不惧，力贯双臂。“看我破了你武家绝技武动山河！”

上官羽也是大言不惭，武子明这个哪里能叫武动山河？别说山河了，就是一颗大树都不一定武得动。

这一次却是两声轰响，上官羽和武子明尽皆倒地。

两人根本就不会什么武打技巧，纯粹就是流氓打架。只是两人比流氓厉害一点，身体素质要好得多。

上官羽和武子明迅速站了起来，两人又冲到了一起。这一刻，没有什么武学招式，只有你一拳我一脚。

“废物羽，你别得意！等我突破到兵极境，必定把你打得半年爬不起床！到时候，看你怎么和我斗！”

武子明本来就要比上官羽逊色一点，打斗时间久了，人极境的元气耗光，这下就更不是上官羽的对手了。

演武场中，只剩下上官羽在虐武子明。

“我说，你别打了行不？我认输！”

武子明心里恨死了上官羽，但是人在屋檐下，不得不低头。

“好吧，今天就教训你到这里，以后还敢不敢叫嚣了？”

上官羽也没有准备继续和武子明计较了，和一个十二岁的孩子计较有什么意思。

这时候，武家的四名侍卫赶了过来。

一名侍卫对着上官羽就是一脚，上官羽打斗了这么久，早已筋疲力竭了。这一脚，仿佛没有封了上官羽的所有退路。如果是全盛状态，上官羽有一定几率躲过，这时候嘛……

“噗”上官羽吐出了一口血，但是并没有惧怕那个侍卫。

武子明被抱在另一名侍卫怀里，被喂入了一粒疗伤丹药。脸色明显好转了起来，可是眼神却很恶毒。

“你们帮我教训下这个废物，快去！出了事情本少爷担着！”

武家四名侍卫二话没说，全都冲向上官羽。

这四个侍卫全都是兵极境修为，根本不是上官羽现在能够抗衡的。更何况还是在疲累的状态下，同时应对四个呢？

四个侍卫，一拳一脚，都运转了体内的元气。上官羽就仿佛是风雨飘摇中的一片落叶，随风飘荡，任雨滴打。

这四个侍卫下手，也都是及其刁钻。专门朝着人体最痛的位置打，但是偏偏又不下死手。上官羽被揍的龇牙咧嘴，但是生命却不可能有危险。

这四个人也不傻，武子明是说出了事情他担着。但是如果上官家三少爷死在这里，那武冲霄绝对会毫不犹豫的牺牲他们四个。

上官家的两名护卫，根本不管上官羽。

上官建城就在旁边，他看上官羽从来不顺眼。小时候，上官惊鸿就疼爱上官羽一个人，对他上官建城是不管不顾。那时候，上官建城心里就决定了，以后一定要上官羽好看。

后来上官建城发现上官羽并不是他的亲弟弟，也就是说并不是上官惊鸿的亲生儿子。直到后来，上官惊鸿发现上官羽不能修炼武道，也就不再管上官羽了，反而更为疼爱他上官建城了。

上官惊鸿常年在外征战，家里就上官建城最大了。上官建城太小，掌管不了整个上官家，但是训几个护卫，还不是小菜一碟。

上官建城早就放出话了，“谁敢救上官羽那个废物，我就将他撵出上官家！”

侍卫们也都是聪明人，谁得势谁失势，他们心里都明白的很。上官羽这个少爷，明显不得家主喜欢。这些侍卫是靠上官家吃饭的，该怎么做他们心里都是清楚的。

在武力至上的飞羽王朝，上官羽这个不能修炼的废物，明显不被大多数人看好。

上官建城冷笑的看着被揍的上官羽，并没有丝毫的同情，反而心里还有种快感。

“我们上官家怎么就出了你这个废物？大哥是武道天才，我将来自然也不差，可是你这个废物是怎么回事？”

上官羽漠然的看了上官建城一眼，“我的事不用你管，你算老几？有什么资格管我？”

“好好好！今天侍卫们都不帮忙，我看你今天能坚持到什么时候？”

上官建城本来就厌恶上官羽，这下被上官羽一冲，更是气得头上冒烟。

武家的侍卫也都知道情况，上官建城从来不管他们如何打上官羽的。只要武子明没说停，他们就准备一直打下去了。

就是其他学员都看不下去了，四个侍卫一起打一个十二岁的孩子，实在是太过分了。

不过碍于上官家和武家的势力，其他人实在是不敢多言。

“你今天不向我求饶，就准备被打死吧！我看你能撑到什么时候！”
content_en:
Scholomance Academy is located on the outskirts of Feiyu Dynasty. It has a long history and has cultivated generations of talents.The college is divided into two departments, the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Military Affairs.There are also junior classes and senior classes. The junior class is for children aged six to twelve years old, and the senior class is for children aged from twelve to twenty years old.

Today happens to be the literary test of the junior class's liberal arts department. Only students who have graduated from the junior class can participate in the literary test.The Feiyu Dynasty used military force to rule the country, but what they wanted was not pure martial arts.

In the examination room, a handsome young man calmly answered the questions on the examination paper.The entire examination room was filled with gorgeously dressed boys and girls, but this boy was the only one wearing simple clothes.

His name is Shangguan Yu, and he is the third son of Shangguan Jinghong, the left general of Feiyu Dynasty.He was unable to practice martial arts since he was a child and was called a waste by those who do evil things.

"Shangguanyu, give me your test paper and let's exchange it!" A young man in colorful clothes from behind kicked Shangguanyu with his foot.

Shangguan Yu didn't even turn around, he knew that the person who kicked him must be Wu Ziming.There have always been conflicts between the Wu family and the Shangguan family. Shangguan Jinghong was the left general and Wu Chongxiao was the right general.The two of them disliked each other and were not convinced by each other.

"The graduation essay test is no joke, you can't cheat!"

"Okay, Waste Yu, just wait for me, you will be finished when the literary test is over!" Wu Ziming held the pen in one hand and clenched his fist in the other hand, waiting fiercely for Shangguan Yu.

Wu Ziming gritted his teeth and looked unhappy.At this time, Shangguan Yu looked at his test paper and suddenly turned his head.

"Okay, Wu Ziming, we can go out soon!" Shangguan Yu was smiling, but in Wu Ziming's eyes, it was a devil's smile.

"Shangguan Yu, Wu Ziming, you are not allowed to whisper to each other in the literary test! Because it is difficult for you to study, I will force you to hand in the paper now! Get out right now!"

Wang Tong, the examiner of the Ministry of Education, was also Shangguan Yu’s tutor.This is a respectable old man with neatly combed white hair and no wrinkles in his clothes.He is upright, does not admire the powerful, and is meticulous in his work.

Shangguan Jinghong and Wu Chongxiao were in power, each commanding an army of millions.Shangguan Yu and Wu Ziming naturally cannot be offended easily.When other examiners saw them cheating, they turned a blind eye.Only Wang Tong was not afraid at all and even drove them out.

Shangguan Yu walked out of the door calmly, even with a faint smile on his face.

But he didn't see the sneer of a young man in the examination room.This young man is Shangguan Jianhong's second son, Shangguan Jiancheng.

Wu Ziming, however, looked resentful and was caught by Wang Tong and forced to walk out of the examination room.If Shangguan Yu hadn't done that deliberately, he wouldn't have been kicked out of the examination room.

"Bastard Yu, don't leave, let's go to the martial arts arena!" Wu Ziming yelled at Shangguan Yu who was not far away as soon as he went out.

"Of course I'll accompany you. I don't know who is more useless. I always call the guards for help!"

"You...! Huh, now I have reached the pinnacle of the Human Realm. I can't compare to this loser like you! You can't practice martial arts, and you will never experience the beauty of the vitality of heaven and earth!" Wu Ziming looked proud. Shangguan Jinghong's second son, Shangguan Jiancheng, could not be defeated by him, but he could still bully this loser.

Shangguan Yu didn't say much, he strode towards the academy's martial arts field.Wu Ziming also hurriedly followed. Both of them were very familiar with the martial arts field.

At this time, the academy's armory was not open, so the two of them could only fight with bare hands.

A gust of wind blew, dust flew, and the two looked at each other.

Wu Ziming had a sneer on his face. At the peak of his human realm, he didn't think that Shangguan Yu would be his opponent.

两人自小就爱打架，只是武子明每次都是被上官羽狂揍。Shangguan Yu's strength has been astonishing since he was a child, far exceeding his peers.How could Wu Ziming, who had not cultivated to the extreme human realm, be Shangguan Yu's opponent?

Today, Shangguan Yu harmed him on the one hand, and on the other hand, he had cultivated to the peak of the human realm, his confidence had skyrocketed, and he wanted to avenge his previous shame.

He didn't even think about it. If he hadn't threatened Shangguan Yu, how could Shangguan Yu have treated him like this?Shangguan Yu is not the one who suffers, and the two have always had a grudge.

Wu Ziming punched Shangguan Yu. There was nothing fancy about it, it was just a straight punch.Shangguan Yu turned aside, waited for Wu Ziming to rush over, and punched Wu Ziming in the waist.Wu Ziming turned around and struck Shangguan Yu with both fists.

The two punched each other with both fists, but Wu Ziming took a few steps back.This was unbelievable to him. He at the peak of Human Realm was worse than Shangguan Yu who couldn't practice.

"Look at my Wu family's unique skills, moving mountains and rivers!" Wu Ziming circulated his vitality and concentrated all his strength on his fists.This was not one punch, but three punches in a row, each punch more powerful than the last.

Shangguan Yu dwarfed his body and swept one leg across, causing Wu Ziming to jump away immediately.Just like this delay, Wu Ziming lost the opportunity and only threw one punch after three consecutive punches.

Shangguan Yu was naturally not afraid and used all his strength to reach his arms."Watch me destroy your martial arts skills and move the mountains and rivers!"

Shangguan Yu was also arrogant, how could Wu Ziming be called Wu Dongshanhe?Not to mention mountains and rivers, even a big tree may not be able to be moved by force.

This time there were two roars, and both Shangguan Yu and Wu Ziming fell to the ground.

The two of them didn't know any martial arts skills at all, they were just gangsters fighting.It's just that the two of them are a little more powerful than the gangsters and have much better physical fitness.

Shangguan Yu and Wu Ziming quickly stood up and rushed together again.At this moment, there are no martial arts moves, just one punch and one kick for you.

"Trash Yu, don't be proud! When I break through to the Bingji realm, I will beat you until you can't get out of bed for half a year! Then, let's see how you fight me!"

Wu Ziming was originally inferior to Shangguan Yu. After fighting for a long time, his energy in the Renji realm was exhausted. Now he was no longer a match for Shangguan Yu.

In the martial arts arena, only Shangguan Yu was left to torture Wu Ziming.

"I said, can you stop fighting? I give up!"

Wu Ziming hated Shangguan Yu in his heart, but he had to bow his head under the eaves.

"Okay, I'll teach you a lesson today. Do you dare to make noise again in the future?"

Shangguan Yu was not ready to argue with Wu Ziming anymore. What was the point of arguing with a twelve-year-old child.

At this time, four guards from the Wu family rushed over.

One of the guards kicked Shangguan Yu. Shangguan Yu had been fighting for so long and was already exhausted.This kick did not seem to have blocked all Shangguan Yu's escape routes.If it were in its peak state, Shangguan Yu would have a certain chance of escaping, but at this time...

"Poof" Shangguan Yu spit out a mouthful of blood, but was not afraid of the guard.

Wu Ziming was held in the arms of another guard and fed a healing elixir.His face obviously improved, but his eyes were very vicious.

"Help me teach this good-for-nothing a lesson. Go quickly! If anything happens, I will take the responsibility of the young master!"

The four guards of the Wu family rushed towards Shangguan Yu without saying a word.

These four guards are all at the Bingji realm, and there is no way Shangguan Yu can compete with them now.What's more, dealing with four people at the same time in a tired state?

The four guards, with each punch and kick, circulated the vitality in their bodies.Shangguan Yu is like a fallen leaf in the wind and rain, drifting in the wind and being beaten by raindrops.

These four guards are also extremely tricky in their attacks.Specifically hitting the most painful part of the body, but not killing it.Shangguan Yu grimaced after being beaten, but his life was not in danger.

These four people are not stupid either. Wu Ziming has spoken out and taken responsibility for the matter.But if the third young master of the Shangguan family died here, Wu Chongxiao would definitely sacrifice the four of them without hesitation.

The two guards of the Shangguan family didn't care about Shangguan Yu at all.

Shangguan Jiancheng was nearby, and he never liked Shangguan Yu.When he was a child, Shangguan Jinghong loved Shangguan Yu and ignored Shangguan Jiancheng.At that time, Shangguan Jiancheng decided in his heart that Shangguan Yu must look good in the future.

Later, Shangguan Jiancheng discovered that Shangguan Yu was not his biological brother, that is to say, he was not Shangguan Jinghong's biological son.Until later, Shangguan Jinghong discovered that Shangguan Yu could not practice martial arts, so he stopped caring about Shangguan Yu. Instead, he loved Shangguan Jiancheng even more.

Shangguan Jinghong was away fighting all year round, and Shangguan Jiancheng was the largest in his family.The city of Shangguan was too small to be in charge of the entire Shangguan family, but training a few guards was not a piece of cake.

Shangguan Jiancheng had already said, "Whoever dares to save Shangguan Yu, that loser, I will kick him out of Shangguan's house!"

The guards are also smart people. They know who is gaining and who is losing power.The young master Shangguan Yu was obviously not liked by the family head.These guards relied on Shangguan's family for their livelihood, and they knew exactly what to do.

In the Feiyu Dynasty, where force was paramount, Shangguan Yu, a waste who could not cultivate, was obviously not favored by most people.

Shangguan Jiancheng looked at the beaten Shangguan Yu with a sneer. He didn't have the slightest sympathy, but he felt a sense of pleasure in his heart.

"How come we, the Shangguan family, have a loser like you? My eldest brother is a martial arts genius, and I will certainly be good in the future. But what's wrong with you, a loser?"

Shangguan Yu glanced at Shangguan Jiancheng indifferently, "You don't have to worry about my affairs. Who do you think you are? What qualifications do you have to care about me?"

"Okay, okay! None of the guards will help you today. How long can you last?"

Shangguan Jiancheng had always hated Shangguan Yu, but when Shangguan Yu rushed at him, he was so angry that his head was smoking.

The guards of the Wu family also knew the situation, and Shangguan Jiancheng never cared about how they beat Shangguan Yu.As long as Wu Ziming didn't say stop, they were ready to keep fighting.

Even the other students couldn't stand it anymore. It was too much for four guards to beat a twelve-year-old child together.

However, due to the power of the Shangguan family and the Wu family, others really did not dare to say anything.

"If you don't beg me for mercy today, prepare to be beaten to death! Let's see how long you can last!"
